subject: Vendor onboarding: choosing invoice transfer channel and minimal payload for PO stamping
messages:
From: Tara Williams <tara@livemart.com>
To: monica_patel@redwood.ai
Date: 2025-11-01T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: New vendor onboarding: invoice transfer options and sample payload

Hi Monica,

Thanks for the quick reply on the onboarding kickoff. A couple of questions from our finance team as we prepare to send invoices:

1) Do you prefer invoices delivered via your portal (recommended) or sent by email to a billing inbox? If portal, can you confirm the portal account creation timeline so we can avoid early invoice emails?

2) If email fallback is required, what subject header convention and attachments do you need so your AP system picks up the PO number? We usually include PO in the subject and a CSV/ PDF attachment.

3) Minimal payload: can you share the smallest set of fields required (PO number, invoice number, invoice date, line items with qty/unit/price, tax, total, remit-to)? We have a couple of legacy systems that can only send CSVs with a fixed column order.

Attaching: vendor_onboarding_form_v2.pdf and sample_invoice.csv.

Appreciate any sample headers or a one-page mapping we can follow.

Best,
Tara Williams
Finance Ops
LiveMart Inc.

---
Attachment: vendor_onboarding_form_v2.pdf (application/pdf, 245 KB)
Attachment: sample_invoice.csv (text/csv, 2 KB)

From: monica_patel@redwood.ai
To: Tara Williams <tara@livemart.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: 2025-11-01T11:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: New vendor onboarding: invoice transfer options and sample payload

Hi Tara — thanks for the attachments and clear questions. Short answers up front, then a few optional paths depending on your ERP constraints.

1) Preference: portal. We recommend onboarding vendors into the Redwood Billing Portal (invite + SFTP/HTTP upload). Portal gives immediate ack, PO auto-match, and reduces manual routing.

2) Email fallback: allowed, but requires strict subject + attachment conventions. Subject: "RDW-PO:<PO_NUMBER> INV:<INVOICE_NUMBER>". Only attach one invoice per email; preferred attachment formats are PDF or CSV. If CSV, header order must match our ingest template (see mapping).

3) Minimal fields (required for PO-stamping and automated ingest):
- po_number
- invoice_number
- invoice_date (YYYY-MM-DD)
- vendor_name
- remit_to_account (GL code or remit code)
- line_item_description
- quantity
- unit_price
- line_tax
- invoice_total

We also need the currency code and an explicit tax amount row if tax is applied.

I attached a single-sheet mapping (redwood_invoice_mapping.xlsx) that shows the CSV column order we need for email ingestion. If you can export to that exact column order, our pipeline will accept invoices without manual intervention.

Operational notes:
- Timeline: portal invites typically go out same day for vendors who complete the onboarding form; portal enablement usually within 48-72 hours.
- For early invoices before portal is active: use the subject convention above and send to billing-invoices@redwood.ai; we’ll ingest and route.
- PO stamping: only invoices with a valid PO in the subject or mapped PO column will be stamped and routed automatically. Missing or malformed PO fields will cause hold and manual review.

I copied Karthik from AP to help with any edge-case mappings (multi-PO invoices, multiple currencies). If you prefer, we can run a short CSV sample through our sandbox ingestion this week and send back the ingest log.

Best,
Monica Patel
Vendor Onboarding Specialist
Redwood Inference

Thanks Monica — this is helpful. A couple follow-ups from our team after looking at the mapping file:

- Our legacy billing export uses column order: vendor_name, invoice_number, invoice_date, po_number, line_description, qty, unit_price, tax, total. Is that okay or do we need to re-order?
- We will likely have a handful of invoices that reference two POs on the same invoice. Can the mapping accept a delimited PO field (e.g., "PO1234|PO5678") or do you require one PO per invoice?

We can do the portal route; if you can send the invite after you confirm the vendor form, we'll proceed. If portal onboarding takes 72 hours we'll plan to send a courtesy email invoice for the first invoice and then re-send through the portal once active.

Hi Tara — looping in to clarify a couple of ingestion constraints and confirm next steps.

1) Column order: our ingestion can remap columns if you send a header row. If you can supply the header row exactly as your export shows (even in the legacy order), we can map it on our side once for onboarding. For long-term straight-through processing we prefer the redwood mapping, but temporary remapping is fine for the pilot.

2) Multiple POs: we do not accept multiple POs in a single line unless you use the portal where you can attach a PO mapping file. For email CSVs, please send one PO per invoice. If you absolutely must send multi-PO invoices, we will treat them as manual exceptions and they will go to hold (and will be slow).

Next steps:
- Monica, please send the portal invite to onboarding@livemart.com once the vendor form is completed.
- Tara, please send one sample invoice export (CSV with header row) to billing-invoices@redwood.ai; mark the subject as: RDW-PO:TEST INV:0001 so we can trace the sandbox run.

We’ll run the sample through the sandbox ingestion and return the log with any mapping/validation notes within 24 hours.

Regards,
Karthik Iyer
AP Integration Lead
Redwood Inference
